name: olio.pb.sourceRange
label: Source Range
description: The span of a source document that a single chapter was extracted from. A lightweight, groupless sub-record hung off olio.pb.book.sourceRange: startOffset/endOffset bound the character range within sourceData, and title carries the chapter heading found at that boundary. Distinct from olio.pb.book.sourceData (which points at the whole document); this narrows that document to one chapter's slice so re-extraction and checkpointing are range-aware.

fields.name: startOffset
fields.description: Inclusive character offset of the chapter's first character within sourceData.

fields.name: endOffset
fields.description: Exclusive character offset of the chapter's last character within sourceData.

fields.name: title
fields.description: The chapter heading detected at this boundary, if any.

fields.name: sourceData
fields.description: The full source document this range slices into. Usually the same data.data as the book's sourceData.
